integrity: The statements are mathematically derived and same-model reviewed only; no independent audit or external certification has been performed. The programs are corroborating finite certificates.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the displayed binary Fermat cubic and its complete reduced geometric-line boundary. The 27-line configuration, 45 Eckardt points and small point-free fields have classical antecedents. Full text of Hirschfeld (1981) and Sturmfels--Telen (2026) was not materially inspected; historical priority is provisional. All-extension proofs use algebraic geometry, not bounded enumeration.
title: The factorial complement of all 27 lines on the binary Fermat cubic
